facts.fact: e-Kash became operational on 14 July with banks, SACCOs and other financial service providers on a common payment platform, and had 3.25 million users by June 2026, according to the National Bank of Rwanda.

The National Bank of Rwanda said e-Kash lets customers transfer up to Rwf10 million for a flat Rwf20 between a bank and another institution, with SACCOs being connected to transfer to banks and other SACCOs.
